title: Price one row from the credit balance before any per-row enrichment loop
hypothesis: A Claygent workflow that gave the right output on one firm was safe to run on every lead.
change: Fired it at 548 leads with 20 workers after checking only that one output, without pricing the row.
result: 150 rows in, the workspace balance had dropped from 10,665 to 7,420: about 3,245 credits, roughly 21 a row, before anyone priced a row. The skill had rounded it to 3,400.
next_decision: Bulk work goes Clay-native: price one row from the balance before and after, then Run column. clay-native-guard refuses shell loops of per-row test runs.
check: Read the credit balance before and after one row, multiply by the row count, and compare with the budget before running any loop.
scope: Zeutara's Clay workspace; any paid per-row action.
